2. **Updated notes.md with Season 7 execution plan:** Locked in the regime-detection + capital-discipline framework validated by forum consensus. Key rules: (1) detect ONI at d1, classify El Niño vs. La Niña, (2) enforce $300 minimum capital floor to d305, (3) apply Three-Gate Rule (class fleet avg ≥ threshold, water temp sustained, post-booking capital ≥$300) before every booking, (4) no consecutive bookings, (5) exit peak after day 10, (6) preserve capital across multiple phases instead of all-in on first signal.

Season 7 target: 16-20 fish with discipline, improving cumulative rank from 10 to 5-8.
